scope: Approved Stage 1 Task 4: real Windows GUI applications in a separate ForgeOS candidate; original user image and overlay were not replaced

candidate.desktop: ForgeDesktop KWin/Plasma, Chinese locale, XWayland, noVNC on the private test relay

notepadPlusPlus.observation: Launched from the Plasma menu; the native Wine window opened a Chinese-named UTF-8 file, appended a line through noVNC keyboard input and saved with Ctrl+S

sevenZip.observation: Launched from the Plasma menu, then opened a Chinese-named ZIP through the desktop-launch file argument with DISPLAY and XAUTHORITY inherited from the actual graphical session; F5 and the Wine Copy dialog extracted one member

sumatraPdf.observation: Launched from the Plasma menu, opened a Chinese-named PDF through the graphical desktop-launch file argument, then used Ctrl+S and the Wine Save As dialog to create a copy

persistenceAndRecovery.firstReboot: Three selected generations and the Notepad++-saved text digest survived a changed kernel boot identity
persistenceAndRecovery.crashMethod: SIGKILL of the checked ordinary-user CompatForge service PID while SumatraPDF was active, in the isolated candidate only
persistenceAndRecovery.crashResult: systemd completed service-group cleanup after approximately the configured 120-second stop timeout and restarted the service; the interrupted job-1790623929149-7 was marked failed with error: service process ended before the job reached a terminal event
persistenceAndRecovery.secondReboot: Three selected generations and all three GUI-produced file digests survived another normal shutdown and new kernel boot identity

verification.compatforgeFullPythonSuite: Not all passing: two migration failures reproduce at pre-Task-1 revision 83079328; three host /proc permission errors passed in the required ordinary-user private PID/proc environment

limits: This is a three-application x86_64 Wine/ForgeOS candidate acceptance, not general Windows compatibility or a completed application store/debugger
The candidate retains the development image's automatic login and has not been switched to the default user session

Plasma PowerDevil held the ACPI power-key inhibitor in the test VM. For each graceful shutdown, the ordinary user stopped plasma-powerdevil.service transiently, verified the inhibitor was gone, and then sent QEMU system_powerdown; no forced reset or guest-root operation was used
The service intentionally limits concurrent long-running application jobs to its configured maximum; the acceptance sequence closed each observed GUI app before the next file launch
A remote acceptance client must inherit DISPLAY and XAUTHORITY from the graphical session; SSH without them yields a headless launch and is not GUI evidence
